get.summary: List model parameters for an agent

post.summary: Create model parameters for an agent

422.description: Validation failed. Emitted as a field-attributed VALIDATION_ERROR by response_handler.validation_error_response, which pins the status to 422 (TraigentBackend src/utils/response_handler.py:361-388), from the BoundaryValidationError raised by validate_model_parameter_bounds (src/routes/agent_routes.py:1164-1181). Since TraigentBackend#3347 this includes an unresolvable `model_id`: `model_parameters.model_id` is a NOT NULL FK onto `models.id`, so the id is resolved against the catalog before the row is constructed (src/validators/persistence_boundary.py `_model_id_references_existing_model`) and `details` carries `{"model_id": ["Field does not reference an existing model"]}` instead of the request reaching the insert and surfacing as a 500.

post.summary: Create model parameters (standalone, agent named in the body)
post.description: The STANDALONE create route — TraigentBackend src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:92 `create_model_parameters`, blueprint url_prefix `/model-parameters` registered under /api/v1 at src/routes/api_v1.py:121. It is NOT a synonym for POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/model-parameters: it takes a camelCase `modelParameters` array, names the owning agent in the body, and does not reject an unresolvable `modelId`. Declared here because it was previously undeclared in this repo, which is why TraigentBackend#3352 could reshape its error body with no contract objecting.
post.x-wrap-status: mixed — `model_parameters_routes` is classified bare in success_envelope_schema.json#/x-wrap-map and the 201 IS bare, but four of this operation's error branches emit the canonical error envelope via response_handler while two emit a bare {error} body. Per-branch shapes are declared on each response below; do not assume one shape for the operation.

201.description: Model parameters created. BARE body (not the success envelope) — src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:298-317.

400.description: Bad request — TWO DIFFERENT SHAPES, by branch. (a) Canonical field-attributed VALIDATION_ERROR envelope: a missing required entry field (since TraigentBackend#3352, src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:128-141 replacing the previous hard-coded "Missing required fields" blob), a non-numeric/non-integral value (:134-139, :148-167 via `_model_parameter_validation_error_response`, src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:42-49), or an out-of-bounds value (:189-196). (b) BARE `{error}` body, still un-migrated: `modelParameters` absent (:114-115) or not a non-empty array (:116-117). Both branches are declared because declaring only (a) would make a conformance lane pass while two live branches violate it.

oneOf.title: Bare model-parameters request error
oneOf.description: Pre-envelope shape retained by the payload-level guards at src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:114-117. Not the canonical envelope: no `success`, no `message`, no `error_code`.

error.description: Either "No model parameters provided" or "modelParameters must be a non-empty array".

404.description: The `agentId` names no agent the caller owns. Non-disclosing by design: an unknown id and another customer's id return the same body (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:250-258). Canonical error envelope with error_code NOT_FOUND; `details` happens to be field-attributed.

422.description: `agentId` absent or blank. ModelParameters carries no tenant/project column, so the agent association is its only possible ownership record and a row created without one is attributable to nobody — the handler refuses rather than mint it (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:240-248). Field-attributed VALIDATION_ERROR at 422, NOT the 400 the sibling validation branches above use — see validation_error_schema.json's note on the 400/422 split.

500.description: Unhandled failure; the transaction is rolled back. response_handler suppresses 5xx detail, so the body is the canonical envelope with a generic message and a sanitized error_code (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:319-331; src/utils/response_handler.py:124-131).
